text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Are they cheering for me? I guess the
days of
huddling up in front of the TV to
watch this race
while stuffing my face
are finished...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's the Arima Kinen, Trainer! Everything
we've
worked for up until now has led to
this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right! I used to think that luck was the
only thing
that could take me this far...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But luck alone will never be enough! It's
because
of all the connections I've
made. That's why I'm
here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You, my trainer, who worked so hard to
nurture
me. All the fans who cheered me
on...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, my classmates, my departed
sister, and
so many others!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru looks up at the sky

resolutely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All those bright lights have gathered
into one
brilliant beam, leading me here.
Today, I won't be
asking the gods for
help...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today... I am Shiraoki! I'm the Lucky-musume who will bring joy to all!
